title: Lions and Elephants
text:
Lions live in Africa. They live in groups called prides. A pride can have many lions. Lions sleep for many hours every day.

Elephants are also big animals. They live in Africa and Asia. Elephants eat grass, leaves, and fruit. They can live for about seventy years.
